title: BOAT Defines a New Future for Automation: Appian is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrantᵀᴹ Report
summary: Learn how we believe BOAT platforms unify process orchestration, AI agents, and legacy tools. Download the 2026 Gartner® BOAT Magic Quadrant™.
body_markdown:
Over the past few decades of digital transformation, organizations have accumulated separate tools for separate jobs: RPA for UI automation, BPM for workflow management, iPaaS for API integrations, and other point solutions.


These investments have delivered undeniable productivity gains. But they've also created challenges: systems that don’t talk to each other, processes that break across integrations, and IT teams that spend more time maintaining the technology rather than innovating with it.


The rapid rise of AI agents has brought this system sprawl to a breaking point. While people can overcome the gaps between systems and inefficient processes, AI agents cannot. If an agent doesn’t have access to the systems or data it needs, the process will come to a halt.


This is one of the main drivers behind the business orchestration and automation technologies (BOAT) market. And it’s a key reason why organizations are starting to turn to BOAT platforms to orchestrate work across their systems.


Here is what enterprise leaders need to know about BOAT, why it matters for coordinating and controlling work across AI agents, and what we feel the[Gartner® 2026 Magic Quadrant™ for BOAT](https://appian.com/resources/analyst-reports/gartner-boat-magic-quadrant) signals for your automation roadmap.
